facts.note: Peak ~4,800 Downdetector reports ~2 p.m. ET; JPMorgan Chase attributed it to a software bug in on-premise hardware, not cyber; transactions processing normally by Monday evening.
Listed by users as down or experiencing issues per Downdetector; Wells Fargo posted a technical-issues notice.
